description: Read the house's page explaining one Christian doctrine or practice (grace, sin, repentance, faith, salvation, the Holy Spirit, the Trinity, baptism, communion, heaven, the church and more). Use for "what is grace" or "who is the Holy Spirit". For the gospel as a whole use the_gospel; for how two traditions differ use denomination_compare; for verses on a life topic use what_the_bible_says_about. Fetched live from living-bread.org/what-christians-believe; page text is the house's words, and up to 4 verses it names are re-read verbatim from the stored KJV. The input is matched to a page by slug, else by words (at least half must appear; exact false when only the closest); no match returns matched null with suggestions. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

topic.description: The doctrine in a word or two: "grace", "sin", "repentance", "salvation", "the Holy Spirit", "the Trinity".

name: belief

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

body.description: Page text, up to about 1,600 characters, in the house's words.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

door.description: Where the person continues on the web.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

exact.description: False when the page is only the closest match to the input.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

hub.description: Index page of the whole collection.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

matched.description: Path of the page used, or null when no page matched.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

related.description: Up to 5 related pages in the same collection.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

suggestions.description: When matched is null: pages the collection holds.

verses.description: Up to 4 verses the page names, verbatim KJV.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: What Christians believe
